title: Sky Jump
summary: A 24 h stage climb with a shared prize pool: offer, matching, tutorial, map progress, win.
description: GameCore SkyJump (stages, pools, the 24 h run) + SkyJumpViews (offer, matching, tutorial, progress map, win).

strings: Advance to next stages for greater prizes!
If you fail a level, you will fail the challenge!

notes: Kit decoupling step: the helpers every event shares are social-ui's (SocEventChrome.swift, Countdown.swift) or ui-chrome's (SocTwoLines); its closure is the events engine (inherent: its pages run the engine's flows, announcements and finish states) + social-ui + ui-chrome.
It borrows the claim screen's letter-pop title (claim-reward: BeatOnce, LetterPopTitle) for its win page: a small, deliberate dependency.
